author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Last Summer announcement trailer for this upcoming asymmetrical horror game. Last Summer will be available on PC via Steam.

In Last Summer, players will either step into the role of a relentless killer, stalking the shadows and hunting down their prey, or fight for survival as part of a group of campers, where teamwork, instinct, and fear are all that stand between life and a brutal end.

What begins as a carefree getaway quickly descends into terror. A group of friends arrives at Silent Lamb Camp ahead of the summer season, filling their nights with laughter, alcohol, and ghost stories around the campfire. But when the tale of a masked killer, said to arrive on a ghostly train and leave nothing but blood and silence behind, turns out to be more than just a story, their final night becomes a desperate fight to survive.
title: Last Summer - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Dreadline Express, a first-person post-apocalyptic Lovecraftian horror game developed by David Konecny. Players will set off on the last human train to unravel a sinister mystery, meet unique strangers, and engage with deep card-based mechanics. Dreadline Express is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Dreadline Express - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Evolvania, an upcoming Metroidvania that invites you to venture into a colossal creature by merging with the environment and enemies. Evolve and acquire new powers. Evolvania will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

In Evolvania, you are a small, sentient eye in search of the legendary collyrium, navigating a hostile and ever-shifting organic labyrinth. What begins as a desperate journey for survival soon unfolds into something far more mysterious, as the creature itself appears to be trying to communicate. Its insides, formed of twisted organs, gnashing teeth, and surreal biological structures, create a haunting world that is as dangerous as it is mesmerizing.
title: Evolvania - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Narin: The Orange Room, a third-person adventure horror game developed by RedSensationGames. Players will embody Narin, who sets out into the twilight dimension in search of her sister. Solve a deep mystery and seek the truth in Narin: The Orange Room, available now on PC (Steam).
title: Narin: The Orange Room - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Blueberry, a story-driven puzzle platformer developed by Mellow Games. Look back on key memories and collect pieces of herself in Blueberry, launching on May 28 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Blueberry - Official Release Date Trailer

description: Take a look at the Season 1 Trailer for Drone Wars, a dark comedic first-person perma-death shooter developed by Blue Shell Media and Groka Games. Players will fight for resources in a war-torn and collapsed America with no HUD, causing players to rely on sights and sounds to locate enemies. Drone Wars is coming soon to PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Beta Launch Trailer for Kiln, an arcade team-based party game developed by Double Fine Productions. Players will sculpt battle armor out of pottery to acquire unique abilities in matches. Make use of team dynamics to take out the enemy's kiln in Kiln, launching on April 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC), with a beta available now on PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Death By Scrolling will be available on Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch on April 16, 2026, with an update for the PC version on the console release date. Watch the latest Death By Scrolling trailer for this endlessly scrolling action roguelite. The update will be available simultaneously on PC and consoles, featuring a new playable character, a new biome, and multiple gameplay and quality-of-life improvements.

Set in the ever-shifting bureaucratic nightmare of Purgatory Inc., Death By Scrolling is an endlessly scrolling action roguelite where players must fight their way upward through monsters, hazards, and relentless pressure from the Reaper herself. The world never stops moving, the floor is always rising, and the only escape is to keep climbing.
title: Death By Scrolling - Official Console Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Restore Your Island is available now on Steam. Watch the Restore Your Island launch trailer for this cozy game about saving a damaged island, rescuing animals, and bringing nature back to life.
title: Restore Your Island - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Town of Zoz is available now on Steam. Watch the Town of Zoz launch trailer for this narrative RPG, rooted in Latin American culture, that makes every meal an adventure.

In the Town of Zoz, players become Ito, a young shaman chef returning to his family’s farm and restaurant in a vibrant village. As mysterious forces cast a dark cloud over the once-peaceful town, Ito embarks on a journey to uncover the ancient secrets threatening his family and friends. Players hunt magical creatures, gather ingredients, cook meals that strengthen bonds with townsfolk, and slash through shadows alongside a shapeshifting spirit companion. Every dish prepared and every relationship forged brings the village closer to healing and reveals the hidden truths of its forbidden past in a story rich with warmth, mystery, and magic.
title: Town of Zoz - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Teaser Trailer for Inquisitor Simulator, a darkly humorous simulation game developed by Edyan Dev. Players will assume the role of an Inquisitor to manage the day-to-day operations of a remote monastery. Manage monks, lead structural restoration efforts, and gather forbidden knowledge for safekeeping. Inquisitor Simulator is available now for PC (Steam).

Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss is launching on April 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and GoG).

title: Paper Perjury - Official Case 6: Regrets & Perjury Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the announcement trailer for A Game About Chopping Trees. A Game About Chopping Trees is a meditative experience built for those who find peace in simple tasks — wrapped in a chill and relaxing atmosphere where there are no timers, no pressure, and no stress. Leave the noise of the world behind and step into the quiet, rhythmic life of a woodsman. A Game About Chopping Trees will be available on PC.
title: A Game About Chopping Trees - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest work-in-progress gameplay video for Exodus. In this new Exodus gameplay video, travel beneath the surface, where ancient Celestial ruins meet flowing fire in a hostile, ever-shifting environment. The new gameplay video showcases Jun Aslan exploring and descending fiery ancient ruins deep underground with companions Tom Vargas and Salt the Octopus. We also get to see the gantlet ability 'Eruption' in action, which can be used to clear debris, shape livestone into bridges and redirect magma flow. Extended gameplay for Exodus will be revealed in summer 2026.

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

Exodus is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG where you become the Traveler—leading humanity’s fight for survival against the Celestials. Face our evolution 40,000 years in the future, explore extraordinary worlds, and confront time itself to shape the fate of generations.​
title: Exodus - Official 'Traversing the Molten Depths' Gameplay Video

description: Don't miss the Buzz Lightyear and Emperor Zurg Reveal Trailer for Fortnite, the third-person hit battle royale game developed by Epic Games. Players can embody legends of Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story IP as Buzz Lightyear and Emperor Zurg make their way to the game. Play as Buzz Lightyear and Emperor Zurg when they arrive to Fortnite on April 10.
title: Fortnite - Official Buzz Lightyear and Emperor Zurg Reveal Trailer

Players can get the rundown on gameplay elements, features, and more while exploring the great outdoors alone or with friends. Grow crops, earn upgrades to the vehicle, and harness energy through renewable means for the journey ahead. Outbound is launching on April 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

Create a customized character and get the win across vibrant themed zones alone or with up to four players. Instant Sports 2 is launching on July 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Nintendo Switch.
title: Instant Sports 2 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest CloverPit trailer for the slot-machine roguelite game to see what to expect with the Unholy Fusion DLC. In this new DLC, exploit the grotesque Surgery Machine to fuse charms into even more powerful ones. Discover 30 unique charm fusions and push your builds further with new memory cards, synergies, modifiers, and fresh regular charms - and break the game all over again! CloverPit: Unholy Fusion is available now on PC via Steam, Xbox Series, Xbox One, Xbox for PC, and mobile. Alongside the DLC, the base game received the free 1.4 update today for all players to enjoy, bringing online leaderboards to the game!
title: CloverPit: Unholy Fusion- Official DLC Launch Trailer| The Triple-i Initiative Showcase 2026

Barotrauma is out now on PC, and the Home & Harbor expansion will be available in fall 2026.

description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. author: GameTrailers
description: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions is a new game set within the Astroneer universe, focusing on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Players will need to work together with their squad and the entire space station crew to explore the planet Tephra, accomplish dynamic objectives, and bring resources back to the station to complete the Starseeker community's overall goals. Check out the Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions' 'Wildlife of Tephra' trailer to see some of the unusual creatures you'll encounter on the ground—creatures they will need to analyze, avoid, or pacify. An upcoming open beta will be available in April, and sign-ups are available now at starseekergame.com. Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions - PC & Console Beta Reveal Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative 26

author: GameTrailers
description: Sledding Game is a multiplayer hangout game where you race down hills, do cool tricks, and crash spectacularly with ridiculous ragdoll physics. Need a break? Hit the chalet to chill, drink cocoa, build snowmen, go ice fishing and more! With proximity chat, character and sled customization, and tons of minigames, it’s all about cozy yet chaotic fun with friends. Sledding Game will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox PC, Xbox Game Pass, and Steam. Sledding Game launches into Early Access on April 30, 2026.
title: Sledding Game - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at The Lift in this new trailer for the upcoming first-person, narrative-driven, supernatural handyman simulator game. The latest trailer for The Lift showcases gameplay and an announcement that it is also coming to consoles. The Lift will be available on PC via Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2027. The Lift will challenge players to renovate what was once humanity's most advanced research facility – the Institute. Now standing abandoned and plagued by cosmic decay, it’s up to you as a Keeper to repair the Institute and uncover its dark secrets before they are lost to the void.
title: The Lift - Official Console Announcement Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Become the legendary minotaur and build the trap-filled labyrinth of your dreams – and their nightmares – in mythical roguelite Minos. Design and re-design deadly labyrinths, set traps, and turn every brave fool into your next victim. Minos is available now on Steam.

description: Check out the Summons Teaser Trailer for Titan Quest 2, an action hack-and-slash RPG developed by Grimlore Games. description: Check out the Preview Trailer for Saros, the upcoming third-person sci-fi action shooter developed by Housemarque. Players will set out as Arjun Devraj, a  Soltari enforcer, to traverse and brave the lands of Carcosa to reveal its secrets one run at a time. Make sense of an ever-shifting planet, a peculiar eclipse that transforms the map, and engage deadly enemies and brutal bosses alike. Saros is launching on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Factions clash for this divided nation’s future — how will you shape its destiny? Take a look at gameplay, enemies you'll face, and the dangerous world of Asterfel in this trailer for the upcoming dark fantasy third-person ARPG, inspired by RPGs from the early 2000s. Asterfel will be available on PC, and a playtest begins on Steam on April 17, 2026.

You find yourself shipwrecked on the island nation of Asterfel: an island plagued by a king’s greed. Every action you take impacts your fate, as well as the fate of the island. Choose which faction to align yourself with, discover more about the world around you through story-rich quests, and steel yourself to free Asterfel from the terrors that plague the land.
title: Asterfel - Official Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Infinity Sweeper, a card-based roguelike deckbuilding game developed by Longshot Studio. Players will methodically navigate grids to uncover numbered tiles, avoid destructive mines, and overcome bosses from run to run. Infinity Sweeper is launching on May 7 for PC (Steam).
title: Infinity Sweeper - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Professional Ship Simulator reveal trailer for this upcoming large-scale maritime simulation game from Aerosoft and SWE Systems. The Professional Ship Simulator showcases gameplay and its system-driven approach to realistic ship handling and operations. Professional Ship Simulator will be available in Early Access on Steam for PC in 2026.

Designed for simulation enthusiasts and professionals alike, Professional Ship Simulator (previously known as NauticXP) will deliver a highly detailed and uncompromising maritime experience, where precision, planning, and technical understanding are essential. Moving beyond simplified, arcade-style gameplay, the simulator focuses on authentic ship systems, real-world navigation challenges, and true-to-life physics.
title: Professional Ship Simulator - Official Reveal Trailer

Update 1 for StarRupture is available now for PC (Steam).
